patterns.note: Overlapping text layers where massive background display type sits behind foreground content blocks, creating a collage-like depth.
Ultra-condensed, heavy uppercase display typography used at massive scales, sometimes overlapping or running off-screen to establish a bold, editorial voice.
High-contrast pairing of deep forest green and stark white, punctuated by vibrant yellow accents for key narrative callouts.
Scroll-driven parallax where background text layers move at a slower speed than foreground narrative blocks, creating a dynamic layered depth as the user scrolls.
Angled color-block transitions that break the standard horizontal grid, leading into the footer with a sharp diagonal cut.

technique_notes: Recreate the layered depth using GSAP ScrollTrigger to parallax massive background text elements while foreground content cards and bright yellow text blocks scroll naturally over them.
Implement angled section dividers using CSS clip-path or SVG masks to create dynamic diagonal transitions between high-contrast color blocks.
Use a custom age-verification modal overlay that matches the brand's deep green and pink color palette, blocking interaction until user input is received.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, ultra-condensed uppercase display headings (~6-8x body size) that overlap with body copy, contrasted with clean, highly readable medium-weight body text.

standout: The site's standout feature is its brutalist, layered typographic collage, where massive background slogans remain partially obscured by foreground content, turning brand messaging into a structural design element.
